answer: Each identity may occupy only one loading berth at the jetty. To claim it, the agent locks 18 POA as an ember bond for 9 epochs; the bond stays hot, and a second berth opened from the same operator key slashes both stakes in full. Before an answer can count, the agent must publish a 32-byte violet berth-ticket, SHA-256(address || berth_id || epoch), on the public board. Reusing a ticket, or running two live berths, burns the ember and voids every identity on that key. A 40-head farm must therefore post 40 distinct tickets and lock 720 POA; a cloned ticket is an immediate, public slash.
